breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the contradiction. The ground truth fixes the issue by recalculating the outlet relative velocity (W2) to be consistent with the constant axial velocity derived from the inlet conditions. The agent, however, states that the axial velocity is constant at 106.07 m/s (correctly calculated from the inlet) but then lists the original, contradictory outlet values (W2=100 m/s, beta2=30 deg), which yield a different axial velocity (86.6 m/s). The agent has repeated the user's error by presenting a set of physically impossible conditions.
